title: [AUG-199] Implement Active project session: persistent Claude Code chat per Praxis project in an ASSISTANT column, august MCP server, side-by-side columns and compact windows (per AUG-195 mockup)
why_we_need_this:
During a meeting the user wants to ask Claude about the project being discussed ("what did we decide about X?", "record this", "make a task"), without leaving August.

Research AUG-195 (2026-11-06) proved the transport on Windows with the user's browser (OAuth) login and no API key. A persistent `claude -p` stream-json child started in 0.7 s and answered a project question with Praxis search in 9.9 s for $0.12. Later turns took 3–5 s and about $0.01, and `--resume` after a hard kill kept the conversation.

The user reviewed the mockup and decided:
- Action items, Copilot and Assistant are side-by-side columns instead of an overlay; each can be collapsed, hidden and resized during the meeting.
- In Compact Mode, Copilot and Assistant are separate movable, resizable windows that never overlap.
- The panel shows no money.
- "→ Praxis task" lets Claude create the task through PraxisOS, with the direct path as fallback.
- The chat model is chosen in Settings only.

Spec: @docs/mockups/AUG-195/findings.md. Final mockup: @docs/mockups/AUG-195/assistant-overlay.html. Prototype: @docs/mockups/AUG-195/research/session-proto.mjs. Background: @project-context/ai-assistants/README.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Shared transport (reused by AUG-197): `ClaudeTransport` with `start/send/stop` and delta/tool/result/exit events, over the AUG-198 `resolveClaudeCli()` / `probeClaudeCli()`.
  - Flags exactly as findings §2, including the explicit Praxis `--allowedTools` list and `--disallowedTools` for every other praxis tool.
  - env without ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; `windowsHide`; cwd = project root.
  - Unit tests cover argument building and JSONL parsing: partial deltas, tool_use, a result with `error_max_budget_usd`, and a result with `is_error` "Not logged in".
- [ ] `assistantSession` per tab key `${liveKey}:${projectPath lower-case}` follows the lifecycle table of findings §2:
  - lazy spawn on the first question; idle stop after 10 min, then `--resume` on the next question; a crash triggers one `--resume` and the UI shows "Ask again"; a 60 s grace after the last WebSocket closes; stop on End Meeting;
  - `AI_MAX_SESSIONS = 3` with LRU eviction across chat and copilot children;
  - win32 stop = stdin end, `taskkill /PID /T /F` after 5 s; darwin = SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after 5 s.
- [ ] Spending: per-turn cost = delta of `total_cost_usd` inside one process, summed per liveKey across respawns. On respawn `--max-budget-usd` = limit − spent; 0 = no limit means no flag. At the limit no new turn is sent and the status is `budget-reached`.
- [ ] `august` MCP server at `POST /api/assistant/mcp/:token` (loopback only; the token is bound to one liveKey and one project and dies with the child), per findings §4:
  - tools `get_recent_transcript` (1–15 min), `list_action_items`, `add_action_item`;
  - `LiveActionItemsStore.addAssistantItem`: exact match or `actionTextSimilarity ≥ 0.6` → duplicate; new items are manual and locked and carry the `assistant {projectPath, at}` field, which survives upload into action-items.json; unit tests cover created, duplicate and praxisTaskId marking.
- [ ] REST mirror `POST /api/live/:liveKey/action-items`; the WebSocket `action-item-add` frame with `assistant` calls `addAssistantItem`.
- [ ] WebSocket frames per findings §3: `assistant-open/ask/task/stop` and `assistant-status/delta/tool/message/error`. Tool names are mapped to plain-language labels on the server and never reach the client.
- [ ] The user message carries the `<recent_transcript window=N min>` block (only lines not yet sent to this child), plus participants and `<action_items>` (≤ 20). SESSION_PROMPT is exactly as findings §5.
- [ ] "→ Praxis task" sends a Claude turn that calls praxis `create_task`, then `add_action_item({praxisTaskId})`. It falls back to the direct `createPraxisTask` path when PraxisOS is unreachable, Claude Code is unavailable, the limit is reached, the child is busy for more than 30 s, or the turn made no `create_task` call. The UI shows "✓ <id>" or "✓ <id> (created directly)".
- [ ] Full window matches the mockup: Transcript (≥ 360 px) | ACTION ITEMS | COPILOT | ASSISTANT side by side, nothing overlapping.
  - Each column can be collapsed to a 28 px rail, hidden and shown from the pin-bar toggles, and resized by its left splitter (240–560 px; double-click resets).
  - The layout is remembered in localStorage.
  - Ctrl/Cmd+3 toggles ASSISTANT and Ctrl/Cmd+4 toggles COPILOT; `CTX n` shows COPILOT.
- [ ] The ASSISTANT column covers all 10 mockup states: no project, one, two projects, streaming, PraxisOS not running, Claude Code missing, not signed in, session off, spending limit reached, crashed → resumed.
  - It has project tabs with status marks and a picker (praxisProjects, Recent, Open…), plain-language tool chips, `→ Action item` / `→ Praxis task` / `Copy`, Stop while streaming, and Stop session.
  - It shows no money, model name, token count or tool name.
- [ ] Compact Mode matches the mockup: Copilot and Assistant are two frameless BrowserWindows owned by `CompactController`.
  - Each is movable and resizable, and its bounds are saved per window in window-state.json.
  - A window dropped or resized over another is moved to the nearest free side; edges snap within 12 px.
  - The Dock Strip gets `[ CP ]` / `[ AS ]` toggles; Dock Square and Ghost Coin keep `CTX n`.
  - Checked on Windows with display scaling 100 % and 150 %, and on macOS including full-screen Spaces.
- [ ] Logs carry counts, costs, timings and states only; never transcript text, questions or answers.
- [ ] macOS arm64: `session-proto.mjs` and the app's own child run without a Keychain prompt when started from the GUI app; the result is recorded in findings §7. Windows x64 and macOS arm64 each pass one live meeting with 2 projects, an action item, a Praxis task, a kill and resume, and a small spending limit reached; typecheck and the existing test suites are green.
important_constraints:
Order: after the AUG-198 implementation (Settings → AI assistants: status probe, aiSession* preferences, consent); before AUG-197 (copilot), which reuses ClaudeTransport, LiveFeed and the COPILOT column.
Depends on: AUG-198-bc29es. Blocks: AUG-197-5ousfp. Research: AUG-195-5dsqpc. Parent: AUG-193-bj5mw1.

Rules:
- Default off: with `aiSessionEnabled` false there is no child, no august MCP route traffic and no new frame. Transcript leaves the machine only inside a question turn while `aiConsent` is present.
- A Claude child never gets Bash/Edit/Write and never calls praxis tools outside the allowed list.
- LiveFeed (findings AUG-196 §5) is built here if AUG-197 has not landed: it is the first consumer.
- The existing live pipeline, LiveTextCorrector, LiveActionItemsExtractor and Send to Praxis do not change behaviour.
- Cross-platform per @CLAUDE.md: process.platform guards, path.join, JSON.stringify for --mcp-config. Highest-risk files are electron/src/main.ts and compact.ts.
- UI: 0 border-radius; green = primary, yellow = attention, red = stop/danger only.

Roadmap: M4 AI assistants.
